These are disposable test identities generated by system OpenSSH and OpenSSL.
They are not user credentials and must never be used by a running service.

`generate.py` records generation and conversion, with canonical OpenSSH public
identities and hashes in `manifest.json`. Plaintext PPK v2/v3 encodings were
independently checked with the original hosted Russh/ssh-key implementation;
its receipt is `original-russh-ppk-validation.json`. DER intermediates referenced
by the manifest are reproducible by the generator; tests embed the PEM/PPK
and OpenSSH files only.
